prompt: A cinematic film still captures a vibrant rooftop party under the night sky. On the left, a woman in a silver dress stands holding a champagne flute, her posture elegant and upright. Next to her sits a man in a blue suit, leaning back casually against a low concrete wall. In the center, a waiter in a black vest hands a tray of appetizers to a guest in a green jacket, who reaches out eagerly to take a canapé. To their right, a couple dances closely; the partner in the white shirt looks at the other in the red skirt with affection. Near the edge of the roof, a brown dog lies on a rug, watching the festivities with calm interest. Behind the dancing pair, a bartender in a striped apron points toward a bottle of whiskey on the shelf. A large potted palm tree stands tall near the railing, its leaves swaying slightly in the breeze. Above them, strings of warm fairy lights crisscross the dark sky, casting a soft glow. A vintage record player sits on a wooden table, spinning a vinyl disc slowly. There is no snow on the ground, and there is no visible security camera in the frame. The scene is bustling yet intimate, with ten distinct elements clearly defined by their appearance and actions within the urban nightscape.
